meta.disclaimer: Not filed data and not derivable from filings. Each figure carries its own basis and confidence.

CRWV.basis: Pure-play GPU neocloud with no legacy business line: revenue is AI compute rental, $1.92B to $5.13B in one year. Residual non-AI is negligible.
sources: SEC filed revenue FY2023-2025 + company description; Claude desk estimate delegated by operator 28 Aug 2026, not operator-researched

sources: Claude desk estimate delegated by operator 28 Aug 2026 — inferred from SEC filed revenue, company segment mix and store thesis data. NOT operator-researched, NOT a filed segment figure.
